authority: Owner decisions accepted by the repository owner on 2026-11-03. An accountable owner is registered only where a component outside the resource's own producer group can reconcile it. Registration confers no standing write or deletion authority.
boundary: A writer is never the accountable owner of its own group. Registered owners read the resource and hold no standing write privilege; every mutation still needs a per-run governed effect grant, and no registration authorizes deletion.
